A Workspace That Fits How You Work

We offer a range of workspace options for individuals and teams looking for a professional, creative environment in Inglewood. Whether you prefer a private office, a dedicated desk, or flexible coworking access, each option is designed with both productivity and comfort in mind.

From private offices to flexible coworking memberships, every workspace supports focus, collaboration, and long-term growth — so you can choose what works best for your needs today, and easily adapt as they change.

VennYYC is an Inglewood coworking space designed for people who want more than a desk at home. That’s why we offer flexible work options, private offices, and a creative community in the heart of Calgary. Located on 9th Avenue SE, our space brings together thoughtfully designed workspaces and a welcoming environment where collaboration comes naturally.

Whether you’re a freelancer, consultant, or small team, VennYYC provides a professional setting that supports both focused work and meaningful connection. With this in mind, our simple, flexible terms and carefully designed spaces make it easy to build a work routine that fits how you actually work — without long-term leases or complicated contracts.

Why Work From Our Inglewood Coworking Space?

Inglewood is one of Calgary’s most creative and connected neighbourhoods — a place where independent businesses, designers, consultants, and entrepreneurs naturally gather. Because of this, working from Inglewood offers the convenience of being close to downtown without the corporate feel, while staying surrounded by local cafés, shops, and green spaces that make the workday more enjoyable.

Located on 9th Avenue SE, VennYYC provides easy access to major routes while remaining rooted in a neighbourhood known for its character and walkability. As a result, it’s an ideal location for professionals who want a workspace that feels intentional, inspiring, and genuinely connected to the community — not isolated or generic.

Ready to See the Space?

Book a free tour to explore our coworking space, private offices, and dedicated desk options. During your visit, we’ll show you around, answer your questions, and help you find the right fit. Afterward , you’ll have a clear sense of which workspace best supports how you work and what you need day to day.
